Honestly, I can’t recommend this place enough! Gareth and Rick are absolute legends and a real credit to the shop. They’re always so friendly, welcoming and happy to help, and it’s clear they genuinely care about the animals and want the best for them.
It’s so refreshing to find somewhere where you’re treated like a person rather than just another customer. They’re knowledgeable, passionate about what they do, and always make you feel welcome, whether you’re buying something or just popping in for a look.
You can tell when people genuinely love their job, and Gareth and Rick are perfect examples of that. The shop itself is fantastic, but it’s the people who really make it stand out.
Massive respect to them both and the rest of the team for everything they do. Absolutely top-class service every single time!

Honestly, the best animal shop in the UK! ❤️
My sister and I go here every week, sometimes for absolutely no reason other than to have a look and have a chat.
Gareth, Rick, Adam, Heidi, Debbie every single person who works here is fantastic. They’re all so welcoming, friendly and knowledgeable, and you can tell they genuinely care about the animals.
We’ve bought around 6 tanks from here in total, with over 50 fish between them, and they’re all thriving!
Honestly, you couldn’t ask for a better place. It’s not just a shop; it’s the people who make it special. You can tell the animals’ welfare genuinely matters to them, and that means everything.
Huge credit to the whole team. We wouldn’t go anywhere else!

Where do I start one day walking past after a hospital appointment for myself  needed more food for my newly diagnosed beautiful boy malachai who  has diabetes got speaking to Rick about all what we had tried with him as needed a very strict diet I had started him on nulo dry food for husky’s along with grain free butchers well time we had finished I long conversation searching all different foods Rick suggested the cold pressed turkey for malachai along with grain free 2months forthglade turkey trays so of I went with a free sample got home gave malachai his evening meal well all I will say is I’ve never looked back I’ve never seen my boy enjoy eating like he is now since his diagnosis control levels no spikes stable solid stools beautiful steady weight gain and to top it all meeting a lovely couple Rick & Debbie who made our first delivery & come to meet malachai which they fell in love with him now we have regular deliveries on a Wednesday to which malachai has met the staff out in the van again they love him and we even had a trip down to the shop to meet other staff had a nice bit of chicken with massive bowl of water honestly I recommend this pet shop more so for anyone’s pets who have been diagnosed with type one diabetes thanks to all staff from the shop to the deliveries to speaking on the phone absolutely fantastic much luv Carley & malachai the husky

I honestly don’t even know where to start. I was greeted with the dirtiest look when entering the reptile room. I asked where certain items were and was met with an incredibly rude and dismissive attitude. I then asked for advice about other reptiles I may consider buying, as well as how to use a particular terrarium product. When I didn’t understand the explanation the first time and asked for clarification, the response was extremely condescending.

I was also continually followed around the reptile room, which made me feel as though I was being treated like a thief. Only one member of staff was genuinely helpful and kind.

I then went into the small animal and fish room. The fish appeared healthy from what I could see, but the small animal conditions were extremely disappointing. Rabbits and guinea pigs had no hay, despite needing constant access to it, and appeared to have straw instead. The hamster enclosures were also concerning as they had no bedding just enough to vover the surface of the enclosurethey were in, and some of the wheels were mesh, which could potentially cause injuries or allow toes to become trapped.

The cages being sold for these animals are also incredibly small and, quite frankly, completely inadequate for their needs.

Overall, I left extremely disappointed. The customer service was poor, but my biggest concern was the apparent lack of appropriate care and housing for the small animals. I expected much better.

Really loved the shop and people working were amazing. I was sad when bethnal green store closed but now Lewisham is one train journey for me plus a little walk. Now this will be my new place to go. We visited today and made the unfortunate mistake of arriving at 4:02pm, believing the shop closes at 4:30pm rather than 4pm. The doors were still wide open and there was still multiple people inside, which understandably gave that impression.

When we tried to ask the male there about an item we wanted to buy, he responded very rudely and aggressively, telling us we were too late. If the shop is closed, that could have been communicated politely and professionally.

What was disappointing wasn’t being turned away, but the attitude and lack of basic customer service. Reading other rude responses (instead of apologising) to negative reviews, it seems this may not be an isolated issue.

Unfortunately, I wouldn’t recommend this shop. There are plenty of other pet stores that offer both quality pets/accessories and respectful customer service.

I had such a wonderful experience with this pet store and felt compelled to leave a review. I recently bought a bunny from them and the whole process was fantastic from start to finish.

First of all, the bundle deal they offered was amazing value. It included everything I needed to get started, which made bringing my bunny home so much easier and less stressful. You can really tell they care about making sure new owners are prepared.

What impressed me the most was how much they care about the animals. They clearly make sure their pets only go to loving, responsible homes and took the time to talk through care and what my bunny would need. It didn’t feel like a typical shop transaction — it felt like they genuinely wanted the best for the animals.

The staff also went above and beyond with their help. They actually carried the cage out with me to my Uber and even helped the Uber driver figure out how to fit the cage safely into the car (he had no idea how to do it even though it was supposed to be an Uber for pets!). That level of kindness and effort really stood out.

Overall, an excellent experience with caring, helpful staff and well-looked-after animals. I’m so happy with my new bunny and would definitely recommend this store to anyone looking for a pet from people who truly care.

This was an upsetting find. Animals were distressed kept in hot, tiny and bright glass boxes wanting to escape. Fish were crammed in together in dirty / empty small   tanks or alone in absolutely tiny ones, not fit for a life. Disgusting!

This was a devastating place to visit. All the animals were trying to escape their small enclosures and just wanted to be free. So many fish crammed into small tanks all trying to escape . I even saw two dead fish in a solo tank . One unusual looking fish was in a tank with NO enrichment whatsoever. If you go in - actually look at the animals and the way they are moving , look at their eyes. See their pain. They do not deserve to be trapped, exploited , abused then bought and sold.

The workers here claim to love animals but all I saw was pure evil. The pet trade really is more evil than I ever knew.

The animals they buy for their shop also come from even worse conditions that would make you sick to know.

Always rescue - do not give this cruel shop and cruel trade ANY of your money.
